scrollableText.title: Au calme de la campagne
scrollableText.body: We look forward to welcoming you to "Au calme de la campagne," located in the Doubs department, known for its blend of historical heritage and natural beauty. The area is home to Besançon and its UNESCO-listed citadel, the picturesque towns of Ornans and Pontarlier, Lake Saint-Point, the Saut du Doubs waterfall, and the Château de Joux fortress.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our website.
By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
content: We collect only the following personal information:
sections.footer: We do not collect names, phone numbers, payment information, addresses, or any other personal data unless explicitly stated.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
content: Your email address may be used to:
list: Authenticate your identity when signing in.
Respond to your requests or inquiries.
sections.footer: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
content: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we process your email address based on one or more of the following legal grounds:
list: Our legitimate interests, provided they do not override your rights.

sections.title: 5. Data Storage
content: Your email address is stored securely using appropriate technical and organizational measures.
We retain your information only as long as necessary to provide our services or comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: 6. Sharing of Information
content: We do not sell your personal data.
We may share your information only when:
list: Necessary to provide our services (e.g., hosting providers).
Required to protect our legal rights.
sections.footer: Any service providers processing your data on our behalf are required to comply with GDPR.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
content: Our website may use essential cookies necessary for its operation.
We do not use advertising or analytics cookies without obtaining your consent where required by law.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights Under GDPR
content: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the right to:
list: Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.title: 9. Data Security
content: We implement appropriate security measures to safeguard your personal information.
However, no method of electronic storage or transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

sections.title: 10. Children's Privacy
content: Our services are not intended for children under the age of 16.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: 11. International Data Transfers
content: If your data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with GDPR.

sections.title: 12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Any changes will be posted on this page together with the updated 'Last updated' date.

sections.title: 13. Contact
content: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your GDPR rights, please contact us.
